transcript: I would say my most preferred society is institutional utopia, because if you have a rule of law, then you have order, then ordinary people can live their lives without fear of being the victim of a crime or having their livelihood interrupted by other crimes like theft or assaults. So I think that a preferred society would be one that has a good justice system and people can live without fear of crime. My least preferred society is definitely the AI centered utopia, because I think that just sounds like a terrible, terrible idea from start to finish, because you don't want something that is smarter than us in a way or that thinks it's smarter than us. That's difficult to control or uncontrollable to be in charge of everything and everyone.
